0784196470884.sourceDescription:
Bring instant festive sparkle to your home with the LOIBUYZ 5ft (150cm) premium artificial green fibre optic Christmas tree. Fibre optic strands are woven through the lush green PVC pine branches and glow in vibrant blue, pink, purple and green, so the tree lights up beautifully on its own - no separate fairy lights to untangle. The foldable hinged branches simply drop into place and the tips can be fluffed out for a full, natural shape, while the folding metal stand keeps the tree steady and upright throughout the season. Lightweight and quick to put up and take down, it packs away easily for storage and can be reused year after year. At 150cm tall, it is ideal for living rooms, family spaces and as a festive centrepiece.
Pre-lit with built-in fibre optic lights for a glowing multicolour display

Lush green PVC pine needles with a realistic, full look
Sturdy folding metal stand keeps the tree stable and upright
Foldable hinged branches - simply fold down and fluff out the tips
Lightweight and quick to assemble, store and reuse every year
Available in 6 sizes: 2ft, 2.6ft, 3ft, 4ft, 5ft and 6ft
Guarantee - 1 year

Assembly required
With stand

This artificial Christmas tree stands 180cm tall and spans 122cm wide, offering a substantial silhouette that fills any living space effectively. The pre-attached hinges allow for quick and easy setup, with branches dropping into place so you only need to shape them for roughly twenty to twenty-five minutes.

Constructed from flame-retardant materials, this Christmas tree provides extra safety for leaves and flocking within family homes. You can enjoy peace of mind knowing the product is safe for indoor use, provided it is not exposed to naked flames.

The folding metal base supports the fake Christmas tree securely, ensuring it stands firmly in place throughout the holiday period. When the season ends, the tree is designed to be taken down easily, allowing for convenient storage away until next year. This practical detail helps maintain the longevity of the tree and keeps your storage areas organised.

Made primarily from plastic, this green Christmas tree offers durability and resistance to wear over multiple years of festive use. The combination of realistic branch tips and snow flocking creates a visually striking display that enhances any interior decor scheme.
Pre-attached hinges allow for quick and easy setup, with branches dropping into place so you only need to shape them for roughly twenty to twenty-five minutes.

0676327436084.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm festive glow to your home with this 6ft LED Red Berry Tree. Clusters of bright red artificial berries decorate the natural-looking brown branches, while warm white LEDs illuminate the tree in the evening. Its slender twig design and square stand make it easy to display in a living room corner, hallway, conservatory or sheltered porch.

Key features

Approx. 180cm (6ft) tall with a slim profile and spreading twig branches.

Bright red artificial berries add festive colour during the day.

Warm white LEDs create a soft glow after dark.

Mains powered and suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

Square stand supports the tree on a stable, level surface.

Reusable seasonal decoration for Christmas and winter displays.

Product specifications

This mains-powered decorative twig tree measures approximately 180cm (6ft) tall. It has a brown trunk and branches, red artificial berries, warm white LED lighting and a square stand. The tree is supplied new and is suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

What’s included

One 6ft LED Red Berry Tree with the manufacturer-supplied square stand and electrical accessories.
6ft decorative twig tree: Stands approximately 180cm tall, with a slender brown trunk and spreading branches that suit hallways, living rooms and entrances.
Bright red berry clusters: Artificial berries bring festive colour to the natural-looking brown branches, even when the lights are off.
Warm white LED lighting: Built-in LEDs give the branches a soft, welcoming glow for Christmas and winter displays.
Indoor and sheltered outdoor use: Display this mains-powered tree in a living room, conservatory, covered porch or sheltered patio.
Square stand included: The supplied stand supports the tree on a stable, level surface.

5056095713184.sourceDescription:
Bring a welcoming glow to your home with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Combining realistic foliage with warm white LED lights, creates a timeless festive centrepiece for cosy evenings and Christmas celebrations.

This Fraser Fir has a traditional silhouette that suits everything from delicate neutral decorations to rich reds and golds. Its mixed tips combine realistic PE foliage with PVC tips to create a full, natural-looking backdrop for your favourite ornaments.

The lights are already fitted, leaving you free to enjoy decorating. Settle on a steady glow for a relaxed atmosphere, add a little twinkle or choose a gentle slow fade. With 8 multifunction settings, you can change the effect to suit the occasion. The lighting is mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently spread the branches and arrange each tip to bring out the tree's full shape, then finish with treasured baubles and your chosen tree topper.

Features:
 Light functions: 8 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 7ft / 2.1m
Diameter: 135cm
Tip count: 1295 (400 PE and 895 PVC)
Lights: 500 warm white LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 5.5 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.

0070621282284.sourceDescription:
PRODUCT FEATURES
Clear plastic ball baubles designed as fillable spheres for Christmas tree hanging decoration. The transparent design lets you see and display small items placed inside, making them suitable for personalised festive ornaments. Available in 6cm, 8cm and 10cm sizes, so you can choose the diameter that suits your decorating needs. Supplied in pack quantities of 5pcs, 10pcs or 20pcs depending on the option selected. The hanging design allows them to be suspended from Christmas tree branches and used as decorative baubles during the festive season.

PACKAGE INCLUDES
Clear plastic ball baubles, in the selected variant. Style and quantity depend on the selected option.
CLEAR DESIGN FOR PERSONAL TOUCHES: Transparent plastic baubles showcase your chosen fillings, making it easy to create decorations that complement your Christmas theme.
EASY TO FILL: Simply remove the top cap, add small, lightweight decorations such as confetti, paper or ribbon, then refit the cap before hanging.
THREE SIZE OPTIONS: Choose from 6cm, 8cm or 10cm diameters to suit your Christmas tree, hanging display or craft project.
PACKS TO SUIT YOUR PROJECT: Available in packs of 5, 10 or 20 baubles for individual creations, coordinated displays or group crafting activities.
VERSATILE CRAFT DECORATIONS: Create personalised Christmas ornaments, wedding favours, party decorations and gift embellishments. Fillings and styling accessories are not included.
Guarantee - 1 month

Product Description

 This set includes two matching Christmas vertical banners. The first banner reads “MERRY” and the second reads “CHRISTMAS”, forming a complete holiday greeting when displayed together.
 Each banner is 30 x 180 cm, large enough to create a strong festive entrance for your home, shop, school or Christmas party.
 The bright red plaid background combined with white typography and snowflake details gives it a traditional Christmas look. It is lightweight, durable and reusable for multiple holiday seasons.
 Hanging is simple with the top rope. Please note that the hanging rope color is random in black or white, and we cannot accept color requests for this item.
 Use them side by side on your porch, front door, fireplace, wall, balcony or party backdrop to spread Christmas cheer throughout your space.

Specifications

 Product Type: Christmas Vertical Banner Set
 Quantity: 2 Banners
 Size: 30 x 180 cm / 12 x 71 inches
 Material: Lightweight Fabric
 Color: Red Plaid, White Lettering
 Pattern: MERRY CHRISTMAS, Snowflake, Reindeer, Santa Sleigh
 Hanging Rope: Included, random black or white color

Package Includes

 1 x MERRY Christmas Vertical Banner
 1 x CHRISTMAS Vertical Banner
 Top Hanging Rope (Random Color: Black or White)

【Christmas Door Banner】Our outdoor Christmas decorations door banner includes 2 porch banners printed with letters "Merry" and "Christmas", 11.8 x 70.8 inches (30 x 180 cm). Equipped with plastic poles and suspension cables, it can be hung well. There are 2 washers at the bottom that can hold some heavy objects to keep the Christmas banner straight and protect it from being blown away by the wind. They can create a Christmas and winter party atmosphere for you.
【Excellent Material】The design of the Christmas door banner takes durability into consideration, and it is made of Oxford fabric. The oxford cloth is not fragile, easy to dry in rainy weather, durable and reusable, wrinkle resistant and lightweight, convenient to store and carry. Very suitable for porch outdoor Christmas decorations.
【Wide Application】The hanging door banners are suitable for indoor or outdoor decorations. You can hang this Christmas door curtain or banner on the front door for your house, doorways halls, ceiling, window, garden, corridor, balcony, patio, porch, entryway Christmas tree decorations or tent to enhance the Christmas party atmosphere and provide a welcome sign for all friends.
【Atmosphere Creator】The mas door banner is designed in red. Xmas red is regarded as a symbol of the precious blood of , carrying the meaning of redemption and hope. Our mas front door hanging banner, against the backdrop of white snow, is like flickering flames, dispelling the cold of winter and highlighting the joy of reunion, connecting tradition with joy. Whether hanging on the door or the house, the red mas porch must be the perfect complement to your mas display.
【Satisfaction Guaranteed】If you have any questions about this mas banner, just contact us via email and we will get back to you within 24 hours until you are satisfied.

5058194839284.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 60 mm. Product weight: 0.25 kg. Quantity: 24 pack.
Pack of 24 festive gold baubles with a sparkling glitter finish for your Christmas tree.
Each ornament measures 60 mm, providing a classic size to complement various tree styles.
Durable plastic construction ensures the baubles are lightweight and shatter-resistant.
Designed specifically for indoor Christmas decoration to add colour and detail to branches.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 24 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

Premium Durable Construction
These pre-lit Christmas gift boxes feature a robust PVC frame paired with finely hand-sewn tinsel fabric. Exquisitely embellished with realistic pine cones and pine needles, they deliver delicate sparkling details, effortlessly upgrading your festive
 decor with authentic Christmas charm.
Warm Enchanting LED Lighting
This set of three decorative gift boxes is fitted with 50 warm white LED lights in total, casting a soft, cosy and magical ambient glow. Ideal for placement under Christmas trees, these illuminated boxes add a wonderful festive atmosphere and a touch
 of magic to your Christmas celebrations.
8 Lighting Modes & Battery Operated Design
The three boxes are equipped with graded LED quantities: 20 LEDs for the large box, 18 LEDs for the medium box and 12 LEDs for the small box. It supports 8 adjustable lighting modes including steady-on, flashing and slow fading to suit diverse festive
 styles. Each box is powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries not included). The cordless battery design enables safe indoor and outdoor use with no need for mains power sockets.
3 Practical Sizes & Space-Saving Storage
This decorative set includes three gift boxes in assorted sizes: 15.5 cm (6 inches), 20.5 cm (8 inches) and 25.5 cm (10 inches). The matched sizing allows easy stacking display and convenient space-saving storage after the holiday season.
Versatile Festive Decoration
Perfect for Christmas and winter festive styling, these pre-lit gift boxes fit a wide range of scenarios. Suitable for indoor ornamentation, holiday party layouts and outdoor yard displays, they blend seamlessly with all Christmas themes and fill your
 home with festive joy throughout the season.

Battery‑Operated LED Lighting - Battery powered without messy cables, creates warm glowing effect for cosy festive atmosphere indoors.
Indoor & Covered‑Outdoor Usage - Perfect for porches, yards, under Christmas trees, mantels and party display layouts.

Bring a warm festive glow to your home with this wooden LED reindeer scene table top decoration, available in a choice of sizes to suit different spaces. The rectangle-shaped design offers a charming seasonal display for tabletops, shelves, mantels, hallways or windowsills, making it easy to style throughout the home. Micro rice LEDs create a soft, cosy light effect, helping to set a welcoming Christmas mood without the need for a mains socket nearby. Finished with woodland-inspired details including twigs, pine cones, red berries, foliage, glittery leaves and pine needles, it adds texture and sparkle to your seasonal decor. Powered by 2 AA batteries (not included), this decorative accent is simple to position wherever you want an atmospheric touch. Made from wood and designed as a festive centrepiece or decorative feature, it brings classic seasonal charm in a refined finish.
Wooden rectangle-shaped reindeer scene creates a charming seasonal focal point for tabletops, shelves, mantels and windowsills.
Available in size options to suit different display areas while keeping the same festive woodland-inspired look.
Micro rice LEDs provide a soft warm glow, helping create a cosy and inviting Christmas atmosphere in your home.
Battery-operated design uses 2 AA batteries, allowing flexible placement without needing a nearby mains socket.
Finished with twigs, pine cones, red berries, foliage, glittery leaves and pine needles for added texture and seasonal detail.

Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The black finish and faux leather construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Bring dark green foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 12 artificial eucalyptus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the dark green colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 12 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.

Decorative Leaf Design: Slender leaf shapes branch along the garland, creating a decorative eucalyptus foliage effect with a glittered surface. The dark green colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark green eucalyptus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 12 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

5056589156084.sourceDescription:
Rich velvet texture and elegant long tails give these festive bows a beautifully traditional finish that works throughout your Christmas décor. This set of 8 decorative bows is perfect for adding extra detail to your Christmas tree, garlands, wreaths or beautifully wrapped presents. Arrange them individually amongst tree branches or position them vertically to create an eye-catching cascading bow display.

Each bow is made from soft velvet polyester, giving the decorations a luxurious appearance that complements both traditional and contemporary festive themes. The generous long-tail design helps them stand out amongst foliage, baubles and Christmas lights without needing complicated fastening.

A practical clip fitted to each decoration makes these clip on bows quick and easy to position. Simply attach them to tree branches, garlands, wreaths or suitable gift packaging, then move or rearrange them whenever you want to refresh your display.

Suitable for indoor use only.

Product Specifications
8 Piece Set

EASY CLIP ON ATTACHMENT: Each decoration features an integrated clip so the bows can be quickly attached to suitable Christmas tree branches, wreaths and garlands without complicated tying.
TREE, WREATH & GIFT DECORATION: Versatile clip on bows can be used throughout your festive decorating, from creating a cascading tree display to finishing beautifully wrapped Christmas presents.
REUSABLE INDOOR DECOR: Move and rearrange the bows as required throughout the season, then carefully store them with your Christmas decorations ready for another year.

5056797098084.variantName: MySmartBuy 54cm Acrylic LED Reindeer, 80 White LED Outdoor Christmas
5056797098084.sourceDescription:
Add a crisp, wintry sparkle to your garden with this 54cm acrylic light up reindeer from MySmartBuy. The durable acrylic body catches the light beautifully and is lit with 80 bright white LEDs for a frosty, elegant glow. At 54cm it suits porches, doorsteps and flower beds, and pairs well with larger reindeer for a family scene. Its weather-resistant lighting is built for outdoor seasonal display, so it will shine throughout the festive season. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 54cm acrylic reindeer | 80 bright white LEDs | weather-resistant | 5m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | outdoor use.
54CM ACRYLIC REINDEER : Lit with 80 bright white LEDs for a crisp, frosty seasonal glow.
DURABLE ACRYLIC : An elegant design that catches the light beautifully.
WEATHER-RESISTANT LIGHTING : Built for outdoor seasonal display.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Ideal for gardens, porches, pathways, front lawns and entrances.

5052532175584.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive fabric wreath designed to add a practical decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Creates a focal point for your arrangement, allowing its outline and details to remain visible.
Single set quantity allows for flexible styling and coordination with existing room accents.
Versatile decoration suitable for marking the occasion and refreshing established displays.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5096042277284.sourceDescription:
Shape the wired PVC branches along a mantel or doorway to display 50 LEDs over a 1.5 m length. There are eight lighting effects, and the timer alternates six hours on with 18 hours off. Three AA batteries are required and sold separately.

A garland lets you carry one theme across a length of the room. It can pick up the line of a shelf, a stair rail or a doorway, tying together different parts of a display without needing several separate decorations at each point.

Carry a colour from the garland into a small cluster of ornaments at either end. Repeating just one shade helps the whole display feel connected without adding so much decoration that the original details disappear. On a staircase, plan the fixing points so the handrail stays easy to grip. Follow the line of the stairs from below as you arrange the length, checking that the lowest sections stay clear of the steps.

Secure the length at intervals with fixings suited to the surface, distributing the weight along its route. This makes it easier to refine the curve or move one section without disturbing the whole arrangement. For a dining table, try the garland along the centre before setting out plates. A shallow curve at either end keeps it within the table outline while leaving the middle available for a low seasonal display.

Use your own ribbon at intervals to introduce a second colour without covering the main decorative detail. If you place it on a shelf, leave the decorated edge visible and keep some space behind it for the rest of the arrangement. A simple background helps the shape read clearly and gives the garland a continuous outline.

When you take the display down, release each fixing in turn and support the loose length as you go. Store it in broad curves, with enough space around the decorative details to avoid flattening them.
50 LED lights with eight lighting effects and a convenient six-hour timer for automated festive display.
Flexible PVC pine branches allow easy shaping along mantels, doorways, or stair rails for custom decoration.
Compact 1.5-metre length is ideal for draping over shelves, tables, or handrails without overwhelming the space.
Battery-operated design requires three AA batteries (sold separately) for flexible placement without cord constraints.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Included: 50 LEDs and flexible pine branches

Snowflake Detail

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display

Care and presentation

7984707619884.sourceDescription:
Bring winter magic to your celebrations with the fiber optic Christmas tree. The soft, colorful glow from the fiber optics adds a warm and festive atmosphere to your home. Additionally, the artificial Christmas tree is beautifully adorned with 14 illuminated snowflakes that perfectly capture the essence of the season. Warm white fiber optics weave through the branches, creating a welcoming and cozy glow that enhances any space. Topping the tree is a glowing star, drawing attention and serving as a delightful focal point. With 8 lighting modes, you can easily set the right mood for any gathering or event. Crafted from PVC, the tree is flame-retardant, smell-less, and non-allergenic, ensuring safety. Premium PVC Construction: Expertly made from premium PVC, the holiday decoration tree is non-flammable, smell-free, and non-allergenic. The materials also resist both fading and warping, ensuring long-lasting performance.
Reliable Foldable Stand: A folding cross-shaped metal base allows for convenient storage and offers exceptional balance for the fiber optic Christmas tree. Additionally, anti-skid pads ensure your floors remain scratch-free.
Suited for Various Occasions: The artificial Christmas tree offers the perfect way to spread holiday joy and celebrate the holiday season. Also, it is an eye-catching decoration for homes, offices, shops, or at special events.
